title: QRBundle QR Set
description: JSON Schema for qrset.json — format version 1.0 (paired with manifest qrbundle/1.0).

id.description: Unique identifier for the QR item (e.g., UUID).

type.description: Item type. Currently only 'qr' is supported.

value.description: The QR code payload, typically a URL.

title.description: Short human‑readable label for the item.
